resourceSchemas.quantity: raw affine-decoded world-space shading normal (RGB) and 2-bit per-object payload (A)
resourceSchemas.units: normal unitless (raw affine value; unit length only after the optional consumer normalize)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: world space (normal); per-object bits are layer-defined

fields.name: PerObjectGBufferData
fields.decode: opaque 2-bit per-object value; interpretation is material/primitive defined

transforms.name: normalizeNormal
transforms.expression: if bGetNormalizedNormal: N = normalize(N_raw); else N = N_raw

mathTerms: N = normalize(N_raw) only when DecodeGBufferData is called with bGetNormalizedNormal=true; the raw decoded value is not guaranteed unit length.
gaps: PerObjectGBufferData (2 bits) has no generic decode in source and is recorded as unknown.
High-precision permutation changes the target to PF_FloatRGBA with 16-bit channels (GBufferInfo.cpp:344-355).
Substrate can bypass this legacy GBuffer (BasePassPixelShader.usf:2386); check r.Substrate before decoding.

The schema stores the raw affine decode N_raw; the consumer must supply DecodeGBufferData bGetNormalizedNormal to decide whether normalize(N_raw) is applied (DeferredShadingCommon.ush:1092-1096). Do not assume a unit-length normal from GBufferA alone.

resourceSchemas.quantity: metallic, specular, roughness and packed shading-model/selective-output ID

fields.name: Metallic
fields.decode: GBufferB.r / 255 (shader .r is memory byte 2 of PF_B8G8R8A8)

fields.name: SelectiveOutputMask
fields.decode: round(GBufferB.a*255) & 0xF0 (high nibble; consumers test mask bits)

transforms.name: decodePackedId
transforms.expression: packed = round(A*255); id = packed & 0xF; mask = packed & 0xF0

gaps: Byte offsets are within the little-endian 32-bit word of PF_B8G8R8A8 (memory B,G,R,A); shader channel names are used in decodes.
Shading model enum values are declared in ShadingCommon.ush and are not enumerated here.
Substrate can bypass this legacy GBuffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: base color (RGB, sRGB-encoded target) plus one of diffuse-sample occlusion / indirect irradiance / AO in A
resourceSchemas.units: linear base color after sRGB decode; alpha quantity depends on permutation

fields.name: BaseColorR
fields.decode: hardware sRGB->linear decode of memory byte 2 (shader .r)

fields.name: BaseColorG
fields.decode: hardware sRGB->linear decode of memory byte 1 (shader .g)

fields.name: BaseColorB
fields.decode: hardware sRGB->linear decode of memory byte 0 (shader .b)

fields.name: Alpha
fields.decode: variant A (default r.GBufferDiffuseSampleOcclusion=0, ALLOW_STATIC_LIGHTING): indirect irradiance = OneOverPreExposure*(exp2(16*A-8)-2^-8), where A includes +QuantizationBias/255; variant B: AO or diffuse-sample occlusion in [0,1].

gaps: Alpha semantic is a runtime permutation: GBUFFER_HAS_DIFFUSE_SAMPLE_OCCLUSION is 0 by default (r.GBufferDiffuseSampleOcclusion=0, RenderUtils.cpp:747-750); ALLOW_STATIC_LIGHTING selects indirect irradiance, otherwise AO.
QuantizationBias (+/-0.5 LSB) is added in BasePassPixelShader.usf:2366/2379 and is not recoverable from the stored byte alone.
High-precision permutation uses PF_FloatRGBA and different packing; Substrate bypasses this path.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-material custom data (RGBA8)
gaps: CustomData has no single semantic decode; per-shading-model meaning is not in this schema.
Target slot index can be 4 or 5 depending on velocity/tangent GBuffer layout.

resourceSchemas.quantity: precomputed shadow factors (optional MRT)
gaps: Target exists only when bHasPrecShadowFactor is set; slot index shifts with velocity/tangent targets (GBufferInfo.cpp:369-405).
Channel-to-light mapping is not stored in this texture.
Not present in final capture ResourceDescs; optional precomputed-shadow-factor target.

resourceSchemas.quantity: device Z depth buffer (reversed-Z projection)
resourceSchemas.units: device Z; linearization returns view-space W (world units)

fields.name: DeviceZ
fields.decode: W = D*InvDeviceZToWorldZTransform[0] + Inv[1] + 1/(D*Inv[2] - Inv[3]); reversed-Z means near=1, far=0 for perspective

gaps: Exact depth format is platform/feature-level selected (PF_DepthStencil family); 32-bit float depth is the common case but not guaranteed by this selector.
Stencil is not decoded.
Final capture resource name is SceneDepthZ (verified in Base/ResourceDescs.json); the selector now anchors that exact name.

resourceSchemas.quantity: card diffuse albedo (sqrt-encoded RGB) plus card opacity (A)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card-space texel atlas; AtlasUV selects card texel

fields.name: Opacity
fields.decode: card base-pass opacity (0 or 1 for masked/translucent); not consumed by CombineLumenSceneLighting

transforms.name: decodeAlbedo
transforms.expression: A = ApplyDiffuseColorBoost((code/255)^2, 1/max(LumenDiffuseColorBoost,1)); ApplyDiffuseColorBoost: if boost<1, C = min(saturate(C * pow(luminance(C),boost) / max(luminance(C),1e-8)), 0.99); finally C = C*View.DiffuseOverrideParameter.w + View.DiffuseOverrideParameter.xyz

gaps: Compressed paths BC7/BC5/BC6H change byte layout; offsets here are the uncompressed PF_R8G8B8A8 path.
BC7 alpha may preserve Opacity but downstream surface-cache sampling ignores A.
DiffuseOverrideParameter default is (0,0,0,1) (SceneView.cpp:905).
Bilinear filtering is applied to the sqrt-encoded texels before squaring; do not square per-texel and then interpolate.

r.Lumen.SurfaceCache.Compress defaults to 1 (LumenSurfaceCache.cpp:27); when the platform supports it, the runtime atlas uses BC7 and the compressed block layout must be decoded instead of these byte offsets.
Final capture Base/ResourceDescs.json reports PF_BC7 for Lumen.SceneAlbedo; the byte offsets in this schema are the uncompressed path and require a BC7 block decoder.

resourceSchemas.quantity: card-space normal XY; Z reconstructed
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card space (capture view axes = card OBB axes)

fields.name: ReconstructedZ
fields.decode: nz = sqrt(max(1 - nx^2 - ny^2, 0.0001)); sign is always +Z in card space

gaps: BC5 compressed layout is not expanded.

The capture shader writes view-space normal from the card capture view (TranslatedWorldToView); that equals card space because the capture view axes are the card OBB axes (LumenSceneCardCapture.cpp:729-732).
Bilinear filtering is applied to encoded XY before Z reconstruction/normalization.

r.Lumen.SurfaceCache.Compress defaults to 1 (LumenSurfaceCache.cpp:27); when the platform supports it, the runtime atlas uses BC5 and the compressed block layout must be decoded instead of these byte offsets.
Final capture reports PF_BC5 for Lumen.SceneNormal; the BC5 block layout is not decoded here, so the runtime semantic decode is partial even though the uncompressed decode is source-verified.

resourceSchemas.quantity: normalized card depth (orthographic card projection)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card space; z from card-plane depth

fields.name: EncodedDepth
fields.decode: D = code/65535; valid iff D < 1.0; encode clamps to (65533.5/65535) and writes 1.0 for invalid; z_local = -(2D-1)*Extent.z

transforms.name: decodeWorldPosition
transforms.expression: P_world = mul(Card.WorldToLocalRotation, GetCardLocalPosition(Card.LocalExtent, CardUV, D)) + Card.Origin

mathTerms: D = (1 - z_local/Extent.z)/2; equivalently z_local = -(2D-1)*Extent.z (orthographic card projection)
gaps: Card capture projection is FReversedZOrthoMatrix with Near=0, Far=2*Extent.z (LumenSceneCardCapture.cpp:695-715); D is normalized ortho depth, not scene device Z.
1.0 is reserved for invalid texels.

resourceSchemas.quantity: card emissive (pre-exposed radiance)
gaps: BC6H block layout not expanded.
R11G11B10 bit order is the DXGI little-endian packing; exact bit extraction is defined by the format, not by shader code.

r.Lumen.SurfaceCache.Compress defaults to 1 (LumenSurfaceCache.cpp:27); when the platform supports it, the runtime atlas uses BC6H and the compressed block layout must be decoded instead of these byte offsets.
Final capture reports PF_BC6H for Lumen.SceneEmissive; the BC6H block layout is not decoded here, so the runtime semantic decode is partial even though the R11G11B10 decode is source-verified.

resourceSchemas.quantity: surface-cache direct irradiance per card texel (pre-exposed)

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

fields.name: IrradianceR
fields.decode: decode unsigned float11; multiply by OneOverCachedLightingPreExposure

fields.name: IrradianceG
fields.decode: decode unsigned float11; multiply by OneOverCachedLightingPreExposure

fields.name: IrradianceB
fields.decode: decode unsigned float10; multiply by OneOverCachedLightingPreExposure

transforms.name: accumulate
transforms.expression: E = sum over culled lights of GetIrradianceForLight(LightData,N,P,Exposure,ShadowFactor); ShadowFactor from packed shadow-mask tiles

mathTerms: E = integral of incident radiance * N.L over the hemisphere (irradiance), stored pre-exposed
gaps: Stochastic direct-lighting permutation writes a different history/atlas pair (Lumen.SceneDirectLighting.*History).
Shadow-mask tile packing (8 or 16 bits/texel) is a separate input; see parameter schema FShadowMaskRay.

Field bit offsets are exact only for PF_FloatR11G11B10 (fields[].appliesToFormats). storage.formatVariants records the explicit PF_FloatRGBA (4x16-bit) and PF_A32B32G32R32F (4x32-bit) channel layouts; format-specific hardware rounding/quantization and alpha use are not claimed complete.

resourceSchemas.quantity: combined surface-cache outgoing radiance per card texel (pre-exposed); rho/pi*(E_d+E_i)+E_m
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card texel atlas; same AtlasCoord as direct/albedo

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

fields.name: FinalLightingR
fields.decode: decode unsigned float11; multiply by OneOverCachedLightingPreExposure

fields.name: FinalLightingG
fields.decode: decode unsigned float11; multiply by OneOverCachedLightingPreExposure

fields.name: FinalLightingB
fields.decode: decode unsigned float10; multiply by OneOverCachedLightingPreExposure

gaps: Quantization seed is exactly int3(AtlasCoord, View.StateFrameIndexMod8 + 2); StateFrameIndexMod8 = FrameIndex % 8 (SceneRendering.cpp:1935). Without the frame uniform the dither cannot be reproduced.
CachedLightingPreExposure default EV=4 -> 1/16 (PostProcessEyeAdaptation.cpp:201-243).
IndirectLightingAtlas downsample clamp is compiled out when RADIOSITY_ATLAS_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR==1 (LumenRadiosity.ush:13); the clamp formula is recorded for the 2x permutation.
Final write to PF_FloatR11G11B10/PF_FloatRGBA/PF_A32B32G32R32F is rounded by the RHI/format conversion; the schema models the shader-side dither but not the hardware conversion rule.

Field bit offsets are exact only for PF_FloatR11G11B10 (fields[].appliesToFormats). storage.formatVariants records the explicit PF_FloatRGBA (4x16-bit) and PF_A32B32G32R32F (4x32-bit) channel layouts; format-specific hardware rounding/quantization and alpha use are not claimed complete.

resourceSchemas.quantity: surface-cache indirect irradiance (SH cosine convolution, pre-exposed)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card texel atlas (radiosity atlas resolution = physical atlas / downsample factor)

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

fields.name: IndirectR
fields.decode: decode unsigned float11; multiply by OneOverCachedLightingPreExposure

transforms.name: shToIrradiance
transforms.expression: E(n) = max(0, DotSH(Sum_i w_i*SH_i, CalcDiffuseTransferSH(n,1))) / WeightSum

transforms.name: temporal
transforms.expression: E = lerp(History, E, 1/(1+NumFramesAccumulated)); then QuantizeForFloatRenderTarget(E, int3(AtlasCoord, IndirectLightingTemporalIndex+2))

mathTerms: SH radiance moments -> cosine transfer -> irradiance
gaps: Temporal history validity requires a valid final-lighting atlas and matching atlas size/format (LumenRadiosity.cpp:646-650).
MaxFramesAccumulated, probe spacing, jitter and plane-weighting are runtime View/CVar inputs.

Field bit offsets are exact only for PF_FloatR11G11B10 (fields[].appliesToFormats). storage.formatVariants records the explicit PF_FloatRGBA (4x16-bit) and PF_A32B32G32R32F (4x32-bit) channel layouts; format-specific hardware rounding/quantization and alpha use are not claimed complete.

resourceSchemas.quantity: 2-band SH radiance moments per probe and color channel, pre-exposed; named IrradianceSH in shader but NOT cosine-convolved
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: probe atlas (physical atlas / probeSpacing); each texel = 4 SH coefficients

fields.name: SH1
fields.decode: SH coefficient V.y = band1 Y1-1 moment

fields.name: SH2
fields.decode: SH coefficient V.z = band1 Y10 moment

fields.name: SH3
fields.decode: SH coefficient V.w = band1 Y11 moment

transforms.name: cosineTransfer
transforms.expression: TexelRadiance = max(0, DotSH(interpolated SH, CalcDiffuseTransferSH(n,1))); if WeightSum > 0: TexelRadiance /= WeightSum

mathTerms: E(n) = sum_lm SH_lm * A_l*Y_lm(n), A_0=pi, A_1=2*pi/3 for Exponent=1

After bilinear probe accumulation, TexelRadiance is divided by the accumulated WeightSum when WeightSum > 0 (LumenRadiosity.usf:543-546); WeightSum is a bilinear sample weight, not a stored SH coefficient.
gaps: Shader local name IrradianceSH is misleading: the stored atlas contains radiance moments before the cosine transfer; transfer happens in LumenRadiosityIntegrateCS.
Probe atlas addressing, probe spacing and temporal jitter (GetProbeJitter) are separate decode inputs.
Only 2-band (4 coefficients) is stored; higher bands are not available.

resourceSchemas.quantity: temporal accumulation frame count per radiosity card tile
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card-tile grid (1 texel per card tile)

fields.name: EncodedFrames
fields.decode: frames = round(code/255*255) = code; shader reads texel*255, increments, clamps to MaxFramesAccumulated, writes frames/255

gaps: Temporal accumulation can be disabled (TEMPORAL_ACCUMULATION), in which case the counter is not updated/used.
MaxFramesAccumulated is a runtime uniform/CVar input.

resourceSchemas.quantity: screen-probe diffuse indirect, Lambertian-normalized irradiance E/pi, pre-exposed with View.PreExposure; composite multiplies by material diffuse color
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: screen pixels; 2D array with closure slices

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

fields.name: DiffuseIndirectR
fields.decode: decode unsigned float11; value is pre-exposed E/pi

transforms.name: composite
transforms.expression: SceneColor += DiffuseIndirect * GBuffer.DiffuseColor * DiffuseOcclusion * EnergyPreservationFactor (+ backface/short-range terms)

transforms.name: preexpose
transforms.expression: TraceRadiance *= View.PreExposure; therefore stored DiffuseIndirect is pre-exposed E/pi

mathTerms: stored = E/pi (Lambertian-normalized); final diffuse radiance = albedo * stored
gaps: The stored value is not outgoing radiance until multiplied by material albedo.
Upsampling/downsample factor and closure slices are runtime; the composite may select a different LumenBufferCoord (DiffuseIndirectComposite.usf:507-517).
The DiffuseLighting accumulator depends on tile-classification/backface/short-range-AO permutations; this schema decodes storage, not every integration branch.

Field bit offsets are exact only for PF_FloatR11G11B10 (fields[].appliesToFormats). storage.formatVariants records the explicit PF_FloatRGBA (4x16-bit) and PF_A32B32G32R32F (4x32-bit) channel layouts; format-specific hardware rounding/quantization and alpha use are not claimed complete.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-pixel history confidence / light-moving alpha [0,1]

fields.name: EncodedAlpha
fields.decode: a = code/255; 0 disables history; valid samples are clamped to >= 0.004 (1/255)

gaps: Clamp 0.004 exists because R8 cannot represent smaller nonzero values robustly (shader comment at line 1457).

resourceSchemas.quantity: downsampled scene depth (linear view W) stored as float bits; sign marks invalid/unlit probe

fields.name: DepthBits
fields.decode: D = asfloat(bits); valid iff D > 0; negative value means invalid/unlit probe

gaps: Sign bit is used as invalidity flag; absolute value is depth.

resourceSchemas.quantity: downsampled world normal, octahedral encoded in RG8
gaps: Octahedral encode/decode maps are in OctahedralCommon.ush; winding/border conventions are not restated.

resourceSchemas.quantity: packed ray direction texel + mip level for structured importance tracing
gaps: Only 6 bits per axis and 4 bits for level; tracing resolution must stay < 63 (ensureMsgf in LumenScreenProbeGather.cpp:2219).
The importance octahedron resolution and mip count are runtime View/CVar inputs.
The shader binding name StructuredImportanceSampledRayInfosForTracing differs from the RDG resource name Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RayInfosForTracing (LumenScreenProbeImportanceSampling.cpp:430-431).

resourceSchemas.quantity: radiance at ray hit / radiance-cache lookup for each probe tracing texel (pre-exposed)

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

transforms.name: structuredImportanceWeight
transforms.expression: SampleWeight = (ScreenProbeGatherOctahedronResolution / MipSize)^2, where MipSize = MaxImportanceSamplingOctahedronResolution >> RayLevel; then clamp max component to MaxRayIntensity

gaps: SampleWeight is the structured-importance resampling weight (solid-angle/mip coverage), NOT BSDFPDF: the BSDF PDF is a separate quantity used during importance sampling.
TraceRadiance is pre-exposure radiance; it is not the filtered/irradiance atlas.
MaxRayIntensity clamp is applied after the weight (LumenScreenProbeFiltering.usf:77-85).

Field bit offsets are exact only for PF_FloatR11G11B10 (fields[].appliesToFormats). storage.formatVariants records the explicit PF_FloatRGBA (4x16-bit) and PF_A32B32G32R32F (4x32-bit) channel layouts; format-specific hardware rounding/quantization and alpha use are not claimed complete.

resourceSchemas.quantity: packed hit distance plus hit/moving/radiance-cache-reached flags

fields.name: HitDistance
fields.decode: d = asfloat(bits & 0x7FFFFFFC); the mask occupies bits[2:30] (29 bits; sign bit is implicitly zero), so the low two mantissa bits are sacrificed for hit/moving flags

transforms.name: decode
transforms.expression: bits = value; d = asfloat(bits & 0x7FFFFFFC); hit=bit0; moving=bit1; reachedRC=bit31

gaps: The low two mantissa bits are sacrificed for flags; exact hit distance is quantized by float bit masking.

resourceSchemas.quantity: packed card-tile -> card-page index and tile coordinate list used by atlas update/lighting passes
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card tile grid within physical atlas
mathTerms: PackedTile = CardPageIndex | (TileCoord.x<<24) | (TileCoord.y<<28); 0xFFFFFFFF is the null tile
gaps: Buffer size is a max/allocation capacity, not a count of live tiles.

Lumen.CardTiles is a unique resource name; the direct-lighting pass is named "Batched lights" (LumenSceneDirectLighting.cpp:1270) and a passNameRegex would create a false negative, so only the resourceName selector is used.

resourceSchemas.quantity: GPU surface-cache page-table sample data: atlas bias, sample res level, sample page index
resourceSchemas.units: bias in 8-texel units; res level; page index

storage.format: uint32 (4 B/element; 2 elements per page-table entry)

fields.name: SamplePageIndex
fields.decode: word1 = index of the card page data (may point to a coarser page)

transforms.name: load
transforms.expression: uint2 v = PageTable.Load2(8*pageTableIndex); bias=v.x&0xFFF, (v.x>>12)&0xFFF; resXY=(v.x>>24)&0xF,(v.x>>28)&0xF; page=v.y

mathTerms: ResLevelXYToSizeInPages(ResLevelXY) = select(ResLevelXY > SUB_ALLOCATION_RES_LEVEL(7), uint2(1u << (ResLevelXY - 7)), uint2(1)) (LumenSurfaceCacheSampling.ush:88-91); no negative shift is defined
gaps: FLumenPageTableEntry in C++ has additional fields not present in this GPU table (PhysicalPageCoord, PhysicalAtlasRect, CardIndex, ResLevel, CardUVRect, SubAllocationSize); they are only in the CPU page table and the card-page data buffer. Do not reconstruct them from this buffer.
Bias units are 8-texel MIN_CARD_RESOLUTION units, not texels.

resourceSchemas.quantity: GPU per-card-page atlas mapping and temporal indices (5 float4 per page)
resourceSchemas.units: mixed: page index, rect UVs, texel sizes, frame indices

storage.format: float4 (16 B/element; 5 consecutive elements per card page)

gaps: Fields with byte offsets describe the 5xfloat4 GPU stream (must match GetLumenCardPageData), not a C++ sizeof layout.
PhysicalAtlasCoord and UVTexelScale are derived and not stored.
Card page data can be stale for unmapped pages; SizeInTexels.x==0 is the mapped test.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-card-tile, per-light bitmask recording uniform visibility (shadow downsample eligibility)

fields.name: UniformVisibilityBit
fields.decode: dword = 8*tileIndex + ((lightIndex & 255)>>5); bit = lightIndex & 31; value 1 = uniformly visible/shadowed so a lower-rate shadow ray may be reused

transforms.name: lookup
transforms.expression: BitIndex = LightIndex & 255; DwordIndex = 8*TileIndex + BitIndex/32; bit = BitIndex%32

mathTerms: bit = (LightIndex mod 256) in one of 8 dwords per tile
gaps: Only 256 light indices are tracked per tile (mask mod 256); collisions are possible for >256 lights.
Dword count is fixed at 8 (Lumen::CardTileShadowDownsampleFactorDwords).

resourceSchemas.quantity: stochastic direct-lighting temporal history: RGB pre-exposed diffuse lighting and A luminance second moment
resourceSchemas.units: pre-exposed lighting; second moment is luminance^2

fields.name: DiffuseLightingR
fields.decode: RGB history lighting; corrected by PrevSceneColorPreExposureCorrection on reuse

fields.name: LuminanceSecondMoment
fields.decode: A = luminance(DiffuseLighting)^2; clamped to Pow2(sample luminance sum) before blending

gaps: Only allocated when stochastic Lumen direct lighting is enabled (LumenSurfaceCache.cpp:268-285).
NumFramesAccumulated history is PF_G8 and uses (N+0.5)/TemporalMaxFramesAccumulated (LumenSceneDirectLightingStochastic.usf:903,930).

resourceSchemas.quantity: packed temporal history frame count and fast-update amount per screen pixel/closure

fields.name: NumFramesAccumulated
fields.decode: code = round(A*255); n = code & 0xF; n==15 means MaxFramesAccumulated else n/15*min(MaxFramesAccumulated,15)

gaps: History validity is external: bAnyHistoryValid and the existence of previous diffuse/depth textures (LumenScreenProbeGather.cpp:1797-1801,1879).
Fast-update amount is a heuristic confidence, not a physical quantity.

resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: 3D clipmap probe atlas flattened to 2D; mip chain

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

gaps: Atlas has a mip chain and per-probe octahedral layout; this schema decodes texel values, not probe indexing.

Field bit offsets are exact only for PF_FloatR11G11B10 (fields[].appliesToFormats). storage.formatVariants records the explicit PF_FloatRGBA (4x16-bit) and PF_A32B32G32R32F (4x32-bit) channel layouts; format-specific hardware rounding/quantization and alpha use are not claimed complete.

resourceSchemas.quantity: world radiance-cache final irradiance (pre-exposed)

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

components.name: A
components.note: alpha channel; unused by the RGB lighting equation

gaps: Probe interpolation (bilinear, plane/visibility weights) is not part of the storage decode.
Not present in final capture ResourceDescs (RadianceCacheInputs.CalculateIrradiance false for that cache); schema retained for the path that allocates it.

Field bit offsets are exact only for PF_FloatR11G11B10 (fields[].appliesToFormats). storage.formatVariants records the explicit PF_FloatRGBA (4x16-bit) and PF_A32B32G32R32F (4x32-bit) channel layouts; format-specific hardware rounding/quantization and alpha use are not claimed complete.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-probe-octa texel trace hit distance encoded in R16_UINT with frontface/twosided flags

fields.name: HitDistance
fields.decode: encoded = f32tof16(d) & 0x7FFE (bits[1:14], 14 bits); decoded d = f16tof32(bits & 0x7FFE); bit0 is bTwoSided, so it must not be included in the distance field

gaps: Bit0 (two-sided) overlaps the low mantissa bit, so hit distance loses that bit of precision.
Backface semantics: bBackface = !bFrontface && !bTwoSided (LumenRadianceCacheInterpolation.ush:289).

resourceSchemas.quantity: 3D probe -> allocated probe index + adaptive probe count
gaps: Texture X coordinate is ProbeCoord.x + ClipmapIndex*RadianceProbeClipmapResolution (LumenRadianceCacheInterpolation.ush:320-329).
NumAdaptiveProbes is 3 bits and only valid for adaptive-probe caches.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-probe-octa depth first and second moments (probe occlusion), PF_G16R16F

fields.name: AccumulatedDepth
fields.decode: mean trace hit distance over the occlusion kernel; two-sided hits are multiplied by 4 before accumulation

fields.name: AccumulatedDepthSq
fields.decode: mean of hitDistance^2 over the same kernel

transforms.name: moments
transforms.expression: M1 = Avg(d*w); M2 = Avg(d^2*w); d *= 4 if twoSided; weights = pow(max(dot(dir,center),0),OcclusionKernelCosineExponent)

gaps: Only allocated when RadianceCacheInputs.CalculateIrradiance is true (LumenRadianceCache.cpp:1479-1526).
The FILTER_PROBE_OCCLUSION path is compiled out by default; the non-filtered path copies one depth texel per occlusion texel.
OcclusionKernelCosineExponent and probe resolutions are runtime inputs.
Not present in final capture ResourceDescs (same CalculateIrradiance condition); schema retained for the allocating path.

resourceSchemas.quantity: denoiser-space specular radiance (RGB) and luminance second moment (A) history
resourceSchemas.units: RGB compressed by denoiser tonemap weight; A luminance^2
gaps: History is stored in a tonemap-compressed denoiser space, not linear radiance.
Validity uses IsLightingValid / INVALID_LIGHTING; the exact sentinel is in StochasticLightingCommon.ush and is not restated here.

resourceSchemas.quantity: virtual page -> physical page mapping and LOD/validity flags (uint per page-table entry)

fields.name: LODOffset
fields.decode: bits[20:25]; 0 = mapped at this mip, >0 = pointer to a coarser mapped page

transforms.name: decode
transforms.expression: x=v&0x3FF; y=(v>>10)&0x3FF; lod=(v>>20)&0x3F; secondary=bit29; validRendering=bit30; anyValid=bit31

gaps: Bits 26-28 are unused (page table format comment).
PageTable is a texture with page-table mips; this schema decodes one entry, not the mip/level addressing.

resourceSchemas.quantity: 6-bit hierarchical page flags (OR-propagated up the page-table mip chain)

fields.name: DetailGeometry
fields.decode: bit3: detail geometry may skip coarse pages

mathTerms: flags are ORed from child page-table mips into parent entries (hierarchical)
gaps: Only bits 0-5 are page flags; VSM_EXTENDED_FLAG_* bits 6-15 live in physical-page metadata, not in this texture.
Must not overflow 6 bits; flag mask is VSM_PAGE_FLAGS_BITS_MASK.
Final capture reports NumMips=7 (page-table hierarchy); each mip stores independent 6-bit flags and is OR-propagated, so a single entry decode is not the whole hierarchy.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-page 4x4 receiver visibility submasks (2x2 texels of 16 bits per page)

fields.name: ReceiverSubMaskBit
fields.decode: mask address: page texel base=(2*pageX,2*pageY); quadrant=(vx>>6 & 1, vy>>6 & 1); sub=((vx>>4)&3, (vy>>4)&3); bit = 1 << (sub.y*4+sub.x)

mathTerms: one 16-bit word per page quadrant; 4 quadrants = 2x2 texels
gaps: Receiver masks are visibility hints for prefiltered distant pages, NOT variance/shadow moments.
The page->texel mapping is 2x2 (not two consecutive linear dwords); use uint2 addressing.
Final capture reports NumMips=8; the 4x4 submasks are per page-table mip and the 2x2-texel-per-page addressing applies to the selected mip.

resourceSchemas.quantity: physical page pool: depth (slice 0 merged/dynamic, slice 1 static) and visualization overdraw (slice 2), stored in R32_UINT
resourceSchemas.units: depth as float32 bits; slice2 overdraw count

storage.arraySlices: 2 in final capture (runtime may be >=3 only when visualization slice is allocated)

fields.name: Depth
fields.decode: slice 0: asfloat(word) = projected VSM clip-space depth; slice 1: static cached depth. Compare against the receiver projected Z (not a variance moment).

fields.name: OverdrawCount
fields.decode: slice 2: visualization overdraw count (not a depth)

transforms.name: initSlice0
transforms.expression: if static cached: slice0 = slice1; else slice0 = 0

mathTerms: depth is IEEE-754 float bit pattern stored in an R32_UINT resource; not a variance map
gaps: This is a depth shadow map, NOT a variance shadow map: the pool stores depth (asfloat) and receiver masks; no variance/moment pair is stored.
Final capture reports ArraySize=2, so only slices 0/1 exist; the slice-2 OverdrawCount field is optional and absent unless ArraySize>=3.

resourceSchemas.quantity: physical page allocation metadata (flags, last request, owner virtual page)
gaps: Byte offsets are shown only as source field order (4-byte uint sequence plus uint2); they are NOT asserted from C++ sizeof/alignment. C++ uses sizeof(UE::HLSL::FPhysicalPageMetaData) (VirtualShadowMapCacheManager.cpp:1131), so stride must be read from the build.
Flags bits 6-15 are physical-page extended flags (initialized/dirty/invalidate/view-uncached/unreferenced/force-cached/deferred-invalidation).

fields.name: IndirectArgsBuffer
fields.decode: RDG indirect dispatch argument buffer; first macro argument is the member name, second is the access mask. Dispatch uses offset 12 bytes (OneGroupPerCardTile = 1 * sizeof(FRHIDispatchIndirectParameters)); see dispatchContract.

fields.name: View
fields.decode: View uniform buffer; supplies StateFrameIndexMod8, PreExposure/OneOverPreExposure and DiffuseOverrideParameter

fields.name: CardTiles
fields.decode: packed card tile list; 24-bit page index + 4+4 tile coords

fields.name: RWFinalLightingAtlas
fields.decode: final lighting atlas UAV; write at AtlasCoord

fields.name: IndirectLightingAtlasHalfTexelSize
fields.decode: 0.5/IndirectLightingAtlasSize; clamp border for the downsampled indirect atlas

gaps: All atlas fields are bindings, not memory layout; decode lives in resource.* schemas.
BilinearClampedSampler is a static bilinear/clamp state; the exact RHI sampler object is created per pass at LumenSceneLighting.cpp:190.
IndirectArgsBuffer is an RDG access, not a shader-visible constant-buffer value; its contents are producer-owned and the dispatch offset is 12 bytes only on the no-padding RHI path.

offsetTable.OneGroupPerCardTile: 1 * sizeof(FRHIDispatchIndirectParameters) = 12 bytes when no platform boundary padding applies

dispatchContract.platformCaveat: FRHIDispatchIndirectParameters is three uint32 counts (12 bytes); RHI.h:542-556 adds padding only when PLATFORM_DISPATCH_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_BOUNDARY_SIZE is 64 or 128. The 12-byte contract is exact for the no-padding platform path; a padded platform changes the stride, not the enum meaning.

fields.name: IndirectArgBuffer
fields.decode: RDG indirect dispatch argument buffer (Batched lights pass); first macro argument is the member name, second is the ERHIAccess range.

fields.name: ShadowMaskTiles
fields.decode: packed per-texel shadow masks (8 or 16 bits depending on colored-light-function atlas)

fields.name: CardTiles
fields.decode: packed card tiles for the dispatch

fields.name: LightTileOffsetNumPerCardTile
fields.decode: offset in low 24 bits, light-tile count in high 8 bits

fields.name: LightTilesPerCardTile
fields.decode: packed light tile: light index 28 bits, view 4 bits; second word shadow-mask index

fields.name: PreViewTranslationHigh
fields.decode: LWC high part of pre-view translation per view

fields.name: TargetFormatQuantizationError
fields.decode: quantization error for direct atlas format

gaps: Field binding names are taken from the C++ parameter struct; the shader also declares globals of the same names.
Light tile packing is decoded in LumenCardTile.ush:84-90 (UnpackLightTileForLightPass).

fields.name: RadiosityCommonParameters
fields.decode: MaxFramesAccumulated, ProbeSpacingInCardTexelsDivideShift, CardTileSizeInProbes and related constants

fields.name: RadiosityTexelTraceParameters
fields.decode: trace radiance/hit-distance atlases and probe trace settings

fields.name: ProbePlaneWeightingDepthScale
fields.decode: depth scale for probe plane weighting

gaps: MaxFramesAccumulated and probe spacing are nested struct fields; decode requires the nested struct declaration (see declaration-index plainStructs/macroDeclarations).
The radiosity atlas is the physical atlas divided by GetAtlasDownsampleFactor()==1 (LumenRadiosity.cpp:280-283).

fields.name: AmbientOcclusionStaticFraction
fields.decode: fraction of static AO mixed in composite

fields.name: ReflectionsCompositeParameters
fields.decode: reflection composite controls (max roughness, fade, bias)

fields.name: bLumenReflectionInputIsSSR
fields.decode: selects SSR vs Lumen specular input

fields.name: DiffuseIndirectSampler
fields.decode: SF_Point sampler for the indirect arrays

gaps: Only the fields relevant to the diffuse/rough-specular composition are decoded here; the remaining bindings (Substrate, hair, SSR tile list, debug output) are present in the declaration index.
The composite apply equation is recorded in resource.lumen-screenprobe-diffuseindirect.transforms.composite.

fields.name: SamplingParameters
fields.decode: virtual shadow-map sampling uniforms (page table, flags, sampler, pool sizes)

fields.name: OutShadowMaskBits
fields.decode: packed shadow-mask output for deferred VSM

fields.name: LightUniformVirtualShadowMapId
fields.decode: virtual shadow-map id for the light

gaps: Projection shader parameter struct also contains hair/Substrate/first-person/debug fields; see declaration-index for the full source-only superset.
FVirtualShadowMapProjectionShaderData byte stride is VSM_PSD_STRIDE = 16*23 (VirtualShadowMapDefinitions.h:113); individual offsets are only partly annotated (LightType 220, ResolutionLodBias 252).
Struct is a decode target; the stored representation is one packed uint (see resource.lumen-card-tiles).
Byte offsets are within the 7xfloat4 (112-byte) LumenCardDataBuffer stream, not a C++/HLSL struct sizeof layout.
Position is LWC DF-encoded (PositionHigh + PositionLow); DFHackToFloat/MakeDFVector3 must be reproduced exactly.
Origin uses MakeDFVector3(PositionHigh, PositionLow), but the source reads PositionLow from V1.w,V2.w,V3.w (stride-coupled).
Packed representation is a uint32; see resource.lumen-screenprobe-tracehit for bit offsets.
Stored in R16_UINT (2 bytes/probe texel); see resource.radiancecache-depth.
Stored as R32_UINT in a 3D indirection texture; see resource.radiancecache-indirection.
Struct is a decode target for one uint page-table entry; see resource.vsm-page-table for bit offsets.

fields.name: MaskPacking
fields.decode: 8-bit: 7 factor bits + 1 complete bit; 16-bit colored: 5+5+5 RGB bits + 1 complete bit

gaps: The structure is not stored directly: ReadShadowMaskRay extracts bits from a packed per-card-tile mask buffer.
8-bit path: ShadowFactor is bits [0:6] (7 bits) and bShadowFactorComplete is bit 7; the previous bitWidth 8 overlapped the complete flag.
16-bit colored path: ShadowFactorR/G/B are 5+5+5 bits at [0:4], [5:9], [10:14] and bShadowFactorComplete is bit 15. No field range overlaps another within a single variant.
Colored-light-function atlas doubles the mask to 16 bits/texel and changes the meaning of ShadowFactor to RGB.

fields.name: LightType
fields.decode: ELightComponentType value; VSM_PSD_OFFSET_LIGHT_TYPE=220 bytes into the byte-address record

fields.name: ResolutionLodBias
fields.decode: per-VSM resolution LOD bias; VSM_PSD_OFFSET_RESOLUTION_LOD_BIAS=252 bytes

fields.name: ClipmapLevel
fields.decode: absolute clipmap level, may be negative; packed with count/index

fields.name: SceneRendererPrimaryViewId
fields.decode: decoded from packed culling view id

fields.name: PersistentViewId
fields.decode: decoded from packed culling view id

fields.name: VirtualShadowMapHandle
fields.decode: handle derived from VSM id/data index

gaps: This is a byte-address decoded record (VSM_PSD_STRIDE = 16*23 bytes, VirtualShadowMapDefinitions.h:113), not a C++ struct. Only two byte offsets are explicitly annotated in source (LightType 220, ResolutionLodBias 252); other field offsets are not asserted here.
Several booleans are derived from Flags, not stored separately.

fields.name: VirtualSmPageTable
fields.decode: virtual page table used to map raster pages to physical pool

fields.name: PackedNaniteViews
fields.decode: packed Nanite views for page rasterization

fields.name: AllocatedPageRectBounds
fields.decode: min/max page rect per VSM mip level

fields.name: UncachedPageRectBounds
fields.decode: uncached page rect per VSM mip level

fields.name: OutDepthBufferArray
fields.decode: physical page pool depth UAV written by the raster pass

gaps: Raster pass writes the R32_UINT physical pool; depth bit pattern is decoded in resource.vsm-physical-page-pool.
The parameter struct is declared with BEGIN_GLOBAL_SHADER_PARAMETER_STRUCT (not a local FParameters); the extractor records it as a named parameter struct.

fields.name: NumCards
fields.decode: number of cards in the scene card buffers

fields.name: PhysicalAtlasSize
fields.decode: physical card-atlas size in texels; used to derive PhysicalAtlasCoord

fields.name: InvPhysicalAtlasSize
fields.decode: reciprocal physical atlas size; atlas UV texel scale

fields.name: IndirectLightingAtlasDownsampleFactor
fields.decode: downsample factor of the indirect (radiosity) atlas relative to the physical atlas

fields.name: CardData
fields.decode: RDG buffer SRV; card records; element layout in resource.lumen-card-page-data

fields.name: CardPageData
fields.decode: RDG buffer SRV; 5 float4 per card page; decode in resource.lumen-card-page-data

fields.name: PageTableBuffer
fields.decode: RDG buffer SRV; packed page-table words; decode in resource.lumen-page-table

fields.name: SceneInstanceIndexToMeshCardsIndexBuffer
fields.decode: RDG buffer SRV; scene-instance to mesh-cards index mapping

fields.name: NormalAtlas
fields.decode: RDG texture; Lumen.SceneNormal (card-space normal); see resource.lumen-scene-normal

fields.name: DepthAtlas
fields.decode: RDG texture; Lumen.SceneDepth (card depth); see resource.lumen-scene-depth

gaps: Exact field count is 19 (source lines 46-64), not 14; fields are typed macro declarations, not C++ ABI offsets.
C++ ABI byte offsets are not asserted. DumpGPU does not serialize RDG uniform-buffer payloads (schema-notes.md 1.1).
RDG buffer SRV/atlas element layouts are decoded by resource.lumen-card-tiles, resource.lumen-card-page-data and the atlas resource schemas; this schema only records the binding declarations.
PhysicalAtlasSize/InvPhysicalAtlasSize and the buffer contents are runtime frame inputs and are not proven by a declaration.
